description: This file defines a PHP class for interfacing with the Firebird database within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It extends base classes to implement Firebird-specific behavior including server info retrieval and SQL limit clause handling.

classes.name: ADODB_firebird
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_ibase, specialized for Firebird database interactions within the ADOdb framework.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_firebird
classes.description: A class extending ADORecordSet_ibase, representing record sets retrieved from a Firebird database.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server information such as dialect version and description.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Implements SQL select limit with 'FIRST' and 'SKIP' clauses tailored for Firebird.
